blog.title: Offa Town
blog.author: Mahmoud Abdulmajeed Taiye
blog.content: "Offa" means arrow in the Yoruba language, and the founder of the town was known as "Olofagangan" the warrior with a sharp arrow. Offa is the cultural headquarters of the Ibolo people, which was regarded as an integral part of the old Oyo Empire. The Ibolos are also found in the present Osun State.

blog.title: One Innovation Hub
blog.author: Bamsky_Dbest
blog.content: ONE is an innovation hub for technology and entrepreneur training programs. Founded in year 2021, ONE innovation hub is a center that provides critical skills training, funding, and support in ICT and business ventures to entrepreneurs. Join us in providing opportunities to the next generation of world-class entrepreneurs from Offa and its Environs. ONE is an innovation hub located within the multi-sectorial Industrial Park in development in Offa. On completion, the Park shall be equipped with five (5) production zones to cater to entrepreneurs who would be engaged in the processing of agricultural products, solid minerals, production of polymer-based products, and creative industry ventures.

blog.title: Prostration In Islam
blog.author: mahmoud Abdulmajeed taiye
blog.content:
Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said, “If I were to command anyone to prostrate to anything other than Allaah, I would have commanded women to prostrate to their husbands. By the One in Whose hand is the soul of Muhammad, no woman will fulfill her duty towards her Lord unless she fulfills her duty towards her husband.”
(Hadeeth reported by Ibn Maajah, 1843; see also Saheeh al-Jaami’, 5239, 5295). 

Messenger of Allah (pbuh) said: “It is not right for any human being to prostrate to another; if it were right for one human being to prostrate to another, I would have commanded women to prostrate to their husbands because of the great rights that they have over them. By the One in Whose hand is my soul, if a man were covered from head to foot with weeping sores oozing pus, and his wife were to come to him and lick his sores (to clean them), this would not fulfill the rights he has over her.’” 
(Reported by Imaam Ahmad, 12153; Saheeh al-Jaami’, 7725).

blog.title: Is First Class Worth The Stress Or Overrated?
blog.author: sanusi oyedeji sanusi
blog.content:
I’m currently studying for my first degree in Statistics. I can graduate with a 2.1 effortlessly, but getting a first-class would require a bit effort. My issue is that I’m already balancing a job, plus I’m feeling lazy and unmotivated about school. 

For those who have graduated and have experience about the labour market, please:

Are there any significant advantages to having a first-class over a 2.1?
Did it make a difference in your career, further studies, or job opportunities?

I need real-life experiences and opinions to convince me whether to put in the effort or just avoid unnecessary stress
